description:
A VA-Spec 1.1.0 ``Data Item`` — one structured datum a Statement consumes.

A curator captures Data Items for a (VBC, MDE) curation; a Statement points at
them via ``hasEvidenceItems``. Per 1.1.0-ballot.2026-09 the entity ``type`` is
always ``"DataItem"`` and the datum itself lives in ``value``.

VA-Spec Data Item has no ``subtype``; SVCv4 adds ``subtype`` as a profile
extension to carry the evidence *kind* (e.g. ``computational_prediction``).

id.description: VA-Spec `id` (0..1): stable identifier for the item.
id.title: Id

references.description: CURIEs / URLs sourcing the evidence (e.g. PMIDs).
references.title: References

subtype.description: SVCv4 profile extension: the evidence *kind* (e.g. `computational_prediction`, `functional_assay`). VA-Spec Data Item has no subtype of its own.
subtype.title: Subtype

value.description: VA-Spec `value` (0..1): the structured datum. Shape is open in the scaffold and constrained by the SVCv4 profile per Evidence Code.
value.title: Value

title: DataItem
